authorization: The user explicitly approved the reviewed V1 presentation-horizon design and authorized execution after freezing the training chronology, RNG, nested-prefix evaluation, and hierarchical outcome rules.
scientific_question: Under the inherited terminal-P regularizer, does variable presentation-horizon training make the clean no-time single-P model a more competent anytime learner than fresh fixed-horizon training, while preserving its historical B=4 phenotype?
claim_boundary: B changes how many times a fixed relation graph is presented. This is a presentation-horizon robustness study, not an information-horizon or new-edge accumulation study.

The scientific contrast is the training horizon schedule: fresh fixed horizon FH always uses B=4 and variable horizon VH uses B in {2,3,4,5,6}. Architecture, optimizer, edge-count chronology, upstream episode randomness, observation arm, update budget, and terminal-P regularization are held fixed within each pair.

A VH advantage is attributable to the registered variable-horizon recipe under the inherited terminal-P regularizer. Because the terminal penalty is not normalized by B, the study does not identify pure horizon variability independently of that known treatment interaction.

Every block re-presents the same episode graph with a fresh order and observation realization under one stable omission. Neither B nor sigma enters the model, so success does not establish explicit time estimation, evidence-count access, or online uncertainty inference.

Three fixed development seeds test continuation of this recipe. A 3/3 result permits a separately registered fresh confirmation; it is not an across-network reliability claim. A 2/3 result cannot be repaired by adding seed 3024.

No scientific seed, cohort, threshold, schedule, regularizer, prefix loss, curriculum, or budget may change after outcome exposure. V2 mixed-reliability training and V3 bridge diagnostics are outside this study.

primary_deployment_cells.A0: clean-trained model evaluated with clean observations
primary_deployment_cells.Ce: noisy-trained model evaluated with inherited sigma=1/7 observations

mandatory_secondary_cells.Ae: clean-trained model evaluated with inherited sigma=1/7 observations
mandatory_secondary_cells.C0: noisy-trained model evaluated with clean observations

design.pairing: Within seed and training arm, FH and VH begin from bit-identical clean-no-time initialization and use the same E_t, graph, cue, subject p/z scaffold, stable omission, six block orders, clean observations, and all noisy draws at update t. Only the retained prefix differs.
design.exposure_barrier: Complete and jointly artifact-lock all 12 final-step models before any registered historical or anytime evaluation is computed. Training losses and registered diagnostics are integrity logs and cannot select a model or alter the recipe.

input_channels.31: one realized signed observation q; zero on queries

architecture.state: One dense P in R^(200x200), reset between episodes and retained across support trials; h and eligibility E reset per trial.
architecture.readout: One binary margin; no L, confidence head, value head, duplicate q, constant channel, reward/action channel, blank step, normalized time input, time parameter, or time buffer.
architecture.query_policy: All 28 unordered queries read clones of a selected P_B with fresh h/E and no P writeback.

training_schedule.construction: Each macro-cycle contains every one of the 20 ordered (B,E) cells exactly once. A fixed recipe-independent RNG pre-generates one permutation per cycle before training.
training_schedule.chronology_gate: For every contiguous registered 20-update macro-cycle, all 20 (B,E) cells occur exactly once. Across 1500 updates every cell occurs 75 times; no implicit short-to-long or long-to-short curriculum is permitted.

recipe_use.fixed_horizon: Use B=4 on every update while retaining the common E_t chronology.
recipe_use.variable_horizon: Use the registered B_t from the common cycle schedule.

training_schedule.exposure_match: Because mean scheduled B is exactly 4 and FH shares E_t, aggregate support presentations sum_t(B_t*E_t) are exactly matched between recipes.
training_schedule.schedule_rng: Use a separately seeded NumPy Generator for each network seed, fully materialize all 1500 (B,E) entries before training, and store the array plus SHA-256 in the source/input lock. No model or observation RNG may affect it.

episode_stream.task: Generic N=8 connected ranking graphs with E_t in {7,8,9,10}, protected Liu graph signatures excluded, one stable omission per episode, and all 28 unordered queries.
episode_stream.max_six_first: At every update, first generate a complete six-block episode stream for all 32 episodes, including graph, cue, p/z, stable omission, six presentation orders, all clean q values, and all sigma=1/7 noisy draws, including unused blocks 5 and 6.

truncation.fixed_horizon: Retain blocks 1:4 only after the max-six stream is complete.
truncation.variable_horizon: Retain blocks 1:B_t only after the same max-six stream is complete.

episode_stream.deterministic_seeding: Derive task and observation seeds from immutable (network_seed, update_index) identities rather than persistent recipe-local RNG state. Regenerating FH and VH must therefore produce byte-identical max-six task and observation arrays before truncation.
fingerprints: prefix fingerprint for every retained B
episode_stream.pairing_gate: Within each seed/arm/update, FH and VH max-six fingerprints must match exactly. Any mismatch is noninterpretable, not a performance result.

optimization.initialization: For each network seed, instantiate one inherited LinearModulationRNN shadow and map every arm/recipe to the same clean-no-time state. Shared initialization tensors must be bit-identical.
optimization.optimizer: Inherited effective-coordinate Adam: base learning rate 1e-4, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, no weight decay, no AMSGrad, multiplier2 on folded bias/q/readout coordinates, weighted backbone global gradient clip2, no scheduler.
optimization.loss: mean softplus(-y*M) over all 28 queries plus 1e-4*mean(P_T^2)
optimization.terminal_regularizer: Keep the inherited terminal-P penalty unchanged and do not divide by B. This is a fixed treatment interaction and part of the recipe-level claim boundary.
optimization.selection: Final update only; no checkpoint selection, early stopping, restart selection, learning-rate change, budget extension, or result-dependent continuation.
training_diagnostics_by_B: Frobenius norm of alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_T
optimization.diagnostic_boundary: Diagnostics are mandatory descriptive outputs, not decision gates and not tuning signals.

qualification.fixtures: Use synthetic non-Liu seeds outside 3021--3023 and outside evaluation panels. Qualification cannot load scientific checkpoints or outcomes.
qualification.schedule: Assert 75 exact 20-cell permutations, 75 occurrences per (B,E), identical E chronology for FH/VH, exact aggregate B*E exposure equality, deterministic regeneration, and schedule-hash sensitivity to any entry change.
qualification.stream: Assert max-six generation precedes truncation; FH/VH full task and observation fingerprints match; prefixes equal direct slices; unused noisy block5--6 draws exist; changing retained B cannot change the next update stream.
qualification.architecture: Assert inherited 32D, H=200, 87003-parameter no-time single-P architecture with no forbidden paths and no recipe-specific parameter or optimizer difference.
qualification.optimization: For B=2,4,6, compare eager equations, loss, terminal penalty, P, gradients, weighted clipping norm, and one Adam update against an independent reference within inherited tolerances.
qualification.nested_evaluation: Assert one seven-block support rollout yields P_1...P_7 identical to independent prefix replays; every 28-query read uses a clone and leaves P_B bit-identical; block7 preserves stable omission while adding a fresh order/observation realization.
qualification.statistics: Synthetic fixtures must cover every hierarchical outcome, strict CE superiority UB95<0, probability non-harm LB95>=-0.02, equal-panel aggregation, arm heterogeneity, and 3/3 continuation without seed replacement.
qualification.cuda: Eager and compiled CUDA outputs, P, loss, gradients, and one update at short and long horizons must match within atol=1e-5 and rtol=1e-4.
qualification.failure: Any failed qualification blocks scientific training. Implementation-only repairs must be append-only and may not alter seeds, equations, schedules, estimands, thresholds, or outcome rules.

evaluation.anytime_stream: For each episode generate one common seven-block stream under one stable omission. Run support once, save P after blocks B=1...7, and query all 28 pairs from clones without writeback.
evaluation.block7: Use the same graph and stable omission as blocks1--6, with a fresh presentation order and fresh clean/noisy observation realization.
evaluation.panels: Three fixed fresh panels per network. Freeze all task, order, subject, observation, and query identities in the source/input lock; share physical episodes and resamples across paired recipes.
evaluation.generic_anytime: For each panel use 256 held-out graph-bucket-zero episodes, balanced as 64 episodes for each E in {7,8,9,10}. Evaluate temperature1 exact-decision probability and query CE for learned and nonlearned pairs at every B.
evaluation.historical_B4: Using fresh frozen inputs under the inherited clean-single-P definitions, evaluate generic competence, Liu_v2 competence and P/evidence binding, Ae/Ce five-flag core, all nine qualitative rows, and A/C compensation at B=4 for both recipes.
evaluation.compensation_scope: Compensation is evaluated only on the historical B=4 task and is not multiplied across anytime horizons.
evaluation.statistics: Use 2000 percentile-bootstrap draws and 95% intervals. Share episode/participant resamples across recipes, horizons, and matched observation cells; aggregate panels equally within each network; never pool network seeds as participants or replace a failed seed.

decision.integrity: All 12 models complete exactly 1500 updates with finite parameters, correct recipe/arm identities, schedule and max-stream pairing, and a joint artifact lock before evaluation.
decision.fresh_FH_qualification: In every seed, the fresh FH pair must pass inherited B=4 generic and Liu competence and binding gates; its Ae/Ce cells must satisfy the inherited five-flag core on at least one of three panels; and its inherited compensation gates must pass. Failure is training_recipe_failure.
decision.VH_historical_absolute: In every seed, VH must independently pass the same B=4 generic/Liu competence, binding, Ae/Ce core, and compensation gates.
decision.VH_historical_continuity: For VH minus paired fresh FH at B=4, require lower95>=-0.02 separately for Ce generic learned/nonlearned and Liu learned/nonlearned/omitted correct probability in every seed. The -0.02 margin is inherited from the previous clean-single-P structural comparison and is not estimated from V1.
decision.anytime_absolute: In every seed and both primary matched cells A0 and Ce, VH generic learned and nonlearned correct-probability lower95 must exceed 0.5 independently at every B=1...7. This is above-chance competence, not equivalence to B=4; monotonicity is not required.
decision.held_out_primary: At each held-out horizon B in {1,7}, every seed and its matched A0 and Ce cell must have paired delta_CE=CE_VH-CE_FH upper95<0.
decision.held_out_safety: At each held-out horizon B in {1,7}, every seed and its matched A0 and Ce cell must have paired delta_p=p_VH-p_FH lower95>=-0.02. Probability is a non-harm endpoint, not a required positive-superiority endpoint.
decision.horizon_improvement: A held-out horizon meets the improvement criterion only when both primary cells satisfy CE superiority and probability non-harm in all three seeds.
decision.secondary_reporting: Report Ae/C0 full horizon curves, learned/nonlearned components, all diagnostics, and all failed cells. Secondary cells cannot rescue a failed primary gate.
decision.arm_heterogeneity: Set descriptive arm_heterogeneity=true when the clean and noisy matched primary cells disagree on a held-out horizon criterion or any registered gate; it does not create or replace the main outcome.

outcomes.noninterpretable: Source, runtime, qualification, schedule, pairing, finiteness, model identity, artifact, or mandatory execution integrity fails.
outcomes.training_recipe_failure: Integrity passes, but fresh FH fails any necessary inherited B=4 historical qualification.
outcomes.historical_task_degradation: Fresh FH is valid, but VH fails B=4 absolute preservation or paired historical continuity.
outcomes.anytime_competence_failure: B=4 historical preservation passes, but VH fails absolute competence at any B=1...7 in any seed or primary cell.
outcomes.no_horizon_benefit: Historical preservation and all anytime competence gates pass, but neither B1 nor B7 meets the registered improvement criterion.
outcomes.horizon_tradeoff: Historical preservation and all anytime competence gates pass, but exactly one of B1 and B7 meets the registered improvement criterion.
outcomes.anytime_admitted: Historical preservation and all anytime competence gates pass, and both B1 and B7 meet the registered improvement criterion.

decision.continuation: Only anytime_admitted with every required gate passing 3/3 seeds permits a separately registered fresh confirmation. No outcome under this development cohort alone promotes a new main model.
decision.stop_rule: Freeze and report the complete result once. If B=4 is preserved but B1/B7 show no registered advantage, close V1 as no_horizon_benefit. Do not change the B distribution, penalty, steps, prefix loss, curriculum, thresholds, cohorts, or seeds inside V1.

execution.runtime: CUDA float32 without autocast or TF32; compiled fullgraph/default training; one Torch/BLAS/compiler thread; float64 summaries.
freeze_points: Commit this protocol and study registration before implementing qualification or exposing scientific outcomes.
Commit the qualified implementation and source/input/schedule lock before training seed3021.
Train all 12 models and jointly artifact-lock them before any historical or anytime evaluation.
Evaluate once, freeze the canonical result and report, preserve positive and negative findings, and stop according to the registered outcome.
outputs: compact sufficient statistics and diagnostic tables
execution.retention: Keep the protocol, qualification, locks, compact sufficient artifacts, canonical result, and report. Do not delete parent or new checkpoints without a later separately authorized retention migration.
